description: skiddle.id's content for a site.standard.document: the post's Markdown, its images, and what Standard.site doesn't have. Goes in the document's open `content` union.

markdown.description: The post body: CommonMark with GitHub's extensions (tables, footnotes, strikethrough). An image is written ![alt](image:NAME), NAME being the name of one of `images`.

category.description: The section of the site the post belongs to. Readers that don't know the value can ignore it.

lang.description: The post's language, e.g. 'en' or 'id'. Absent means English.

series.description: The series the post is a part of, if any.

featured.description: Shown first on the home page.

name.description: How the Markdown refers to the image: ![alt](image:NAME). Unique within the post.

alt.description: Text for people who can't see the image.

width.description: In pixels, so the page doesn't jump while it loads.

part.description: Which part of the series it is, from 1.
